es: Matizar un desacuerdo con distancia y concesión: seem y appear, might, somewhat, arguably, preguntas indirectas con whether y los conectores albeit y notwithstanding.

teaching.en: The plan seems somewhat expensive for a small club, although it would seem that the members are willing to pay more.
teaching.es: El plan parece algo caro para un club pequeño, aunque parecería que los socios están dispuestos a pagar más.
teaching.explanationEs: seem + adjetivo presenta una impresión; somewhat baja la fuerza; it would seem that toma aún más distancia.
segments: The plan seems somewhat expensive for a small club, although it
would seem that the members are willing to pay more.
teaching.audioText: The plan seems somewhat expensive for a small club, although it would seem that the members are willing to pay more.

teaching.en: Some members appear to have a different view, and the committee might possibly need more time than it has.
teaching.es: Algunos socios parecen tener una opinión distinta, y el comité quizá necesite más tiempo del que tiene.
teaching.explanationEs: appear to + verbo describe cómo parece algo; might + possibly acumula dos suavizantes de posibilidad.
segments: Some members appear to have a different view, and the
committee might possibly need more time than it has.
teaching.audioText: Some members appear to have a different view, and the committee might possibly need more time than it has.

teaching.en: That is arguably the safest option, albeit not the cheapest, and to a certain extent it reflects what members asked for.
teaching.es: Esa es posiblemente la opción más segura, aunque no la más barata, y hasta cierto punto refleja lo que pidieron los socios.
teaching.explanationEs: albeit + grupo breve: concesión corta; to a certain extent limita el alcance de lo que afirmas.
segments: That is arguably the safest option, albeit not the cheapest, and
to a certain extent it reflects what members asked for.
teaching.audioText: That is arguably the safest option, albeit not the cheapest, and to a certain extent it reflects what members asked for.

teaching.en: Notwithstanding the cost, I think the trip is worth it, although it could be argued that a cheaper venue would do just as well.
teaching.es: A pesar del costo, creo que el viaje merece la pena, aunque se podría argumentar que un lugar más barato serviría igual de bien.
teaching.explanationEs: notwithstanding + nombre reconoce un punto contrario; it could be argued that presenta una objeción sin hacerla tuya.
segments: Notwithstanding the cost, I think the trip is worth it, although it
could be argued that a cheaper venue would do just as well.
teaching.audioText: Notwithstanding the cost, I think the trip is worth it, although it could be argued that a cheaper venue would do just as well.

teaching.en: Could you tell me whether the budget is already fixed, or whether the committee is still looking at other options?
teaching.es: ¿Podrías decirme si el presupuesto ya está fijado, o si el comité todavía está estudiando otras opciones?
teaching.explanationEs: Pregunta indirecta: whether + orden de afirmación, sin inversión del auxiliar.
segments: Could you tell me whether the budget is already fixed,
or whether the committee is still looking at other options?
teaching.audioText: Could you tell me whether the budget is already fixed, or whether the committee is still looking at other options?

teaching.en: Hedging does not mean avoiding the point: a careful verb and an adverb such as somewhat let you say what you think without closing the conversation.
teaching.es: Matizar no es esquivar el asunto: un verbo prudente y un adverbio como «algo» permiten decir lo que piensas sin cerrar la conversación.
teaching.explanationEs: El objetivo de matizar es que la otra persona pueda seguir hablando contigo, no borrar tu opinión.
segments: Hedging does not mean avoiding the point: a careful verb and an adverb
such as somewhat let you say what you think without closing the conversation.

prompt.es: Elige la versión con seem que suaviza la frase directa sobre el presupuesto.

choices.text: Your plan seems somewhat expensive compared with our budget.
Your plan is seeming somewhat expensive compared with our budget.
Your plan seems that it is somewhat expensive for our budget.

feedback.es: Seem + adjetivo funciona sin más (seems somewhat expensive); seem no se usa en forma continua ni con that + it is después de seems.

hint.es: Busca la opción en la que seem va directamente con el adjetivo.

origin.text: A colleague's plan for the club dinner will cost twice the agreed budget. You want to say so without sounding hostile.

prompt.es: Completa: «¿Podrías decirme si el presupuesto está fijado?»

feedback.es: Whether introduce una pregunta indirecta con orden de afirmación.

hint.es: Es la palabra que introduce una pregunta de sí o no dentro de otra frase.

origin.text: Could you tell me ___ the budget is already fixed? We need to know before we book the room.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Algunos socios parecen tener una opinión bastante distinta sobre la fecha.»

answer.text: Some members appear to have a rather different opinion about the date

feedback.es: Appear to + verbo presenta la opinión como una impresión; rather suaviza different.

hint.es: El verbo appear va seguido de to + verbo.

prompt.es: Completa cada frase diplomática con la palabra que encaja.

feedback.es: Whether abre una pregunta indirecta, appear to toma distancia y might presenta la posibilidad sin afirmarla.

sentences: I am not sure ___ the committee has reached a decision.
The results ___ to suggest a link, albeit a weak one.
The new schedule ___ need some changes before Friday.

prompt.es: Escucha el relato de la reunión y elige qué opina la tesorera del plan.

choices.text: It is too expensive, so the club should drop the idea.
It is promising, but she has doubts about time and support.
It is perfect, and she wants to start work at once.

feedback.es: Matiza con seemed somewhat ambitious, might possibly y una pregunta sobre los patrocinadores: valora la idea pero deja ver dudas.

origin.audio: At the club meeting, the treasurer summarised the proposal for the tournament. The plan, she said, seemed somewhat ambitious, albeit well organised, and it might possibly need more time than the committee had. Notwithstanding the cost, she thought the idea was arguably the club's best in years. She asked whether the sponsors had confirmed their support, and several members appeared to share her doubts. The chair said that he would ask them again on Monday.

prompt.es: Une cada recurso con su efecto en español.

pairs.es: se podría argumentar que (objeción sin asumirla)

feedback.es: Cada recurso quita fuerza o reconoce un punto contrario de una manera distinta.

pairs.es: se podría argumentar que (objeción sin asumirla)

prompt.es: ¿Qué pregunta indirecta completa correctamente el correo al hotel?

choices.text: Could you tell me whether has the room a projector?
Could you tell me does the room have a projector?
Could you tell me whether the room has a projector?

feedback.es: En la pregunta indirecta se usa whether + orden de afirmación: whether the room has a projector.

origin.text: Dear Sir or Madam, we are booking a room for our yearly meeting next month. Before we confirm the booking, we would like to ask you a question about the equipment, because some of our members will give presentations during the morning session.

prompt.es: Completa: «La propuesta es un intento serio, aunque no perfecto.»

feedback.es: Albeit introduce una concesión breve sin verbo conjugado.

origin.text: The proposal is a serious attempt to solve the problem, ___ not a perfect one. I am not sure it is enough, but it is a start.

prompt.es: Escucha el fragmento y elige qué actitud muestran los autores ante sus datos.

choices.text: Cautious: they present the link as possible, not proven.
Confident: they present the link as certain and general.
Sceptical: they reject the link as an accident.

feedback.es: Seem to, weak, might possibly y stop short of una conclusión firme muestran cautela: el vínculo es posible, no demostrado.

origin.audio: The report says that the data seem to point to a link between sleep and memory, albeit a weak one. The authors add that the effect might possibly disappear in larger samples. They stop short of any firm conclusion, and arguably that caution is the most honest part of the whole article.

prompt.es: Ordena: «A pesar del costo, parecería que el viaje merece la pena.»

answer.text: Notwithstanding the cost, it would seem that the trip is worth it
accepted: Notwithstanding the cost, it would seem that the trip is worth it
It would seem that the trip is worth it notwithstanding the cost

feedback.es: Notwithstanding + nombre abre la concesión y después viene la posición con it would seem that.

prompt.es: ¿Qué busca Sara con este mensaje al grupo?

choices.text: To announce that the hotel has cancelled the booking.
To complain that the party will be too expensive.
To insist that the hotel must give a larger room.
To raise a doubt without blaming anyone and ask for help.

feedback.es: Con it would appear, may, might y perhaps plantea un problema posible, no un reproche, y pide que alguien lo compruebe.

origin.text: Dear all, it would appear that the room may be somewhat small for the party, since more guests have replied than we expected. I might be wrong, and perhaps the hotel can offer a larger one. Could someone find out whether that is possible? Thanks, Sara.

prompt.es: Suaviza la frase directa con seem o appear y un modal de posibilidad.

answer.text: The schedule seems somewhat tight, and the team might not finish on time.
accepted: The schedule seems somewhat tight, and the team might not finish on time.
The schedule appears to be rather tight, and the team might not be able to finish on time.
It seems that the schedule is somewhat tight, and that the team might not finish on time.

feedback.es: Seem o appear convierten «is too tight» en una impresión, y might suaviza la predicción.

origin.text: Frase directa: «The schedule is too tight and the team will not finish on time.» Reescríbela con seem o appear y might.

prompt.es: Completa: «Esta es, según se mire, la mejor opción.»

feedback.es: Arguably marca que es una opinión defendible, no un hecho.

origin.text: Several options were considered during the meeting. This is ___ the best one, although the others have some merits as well.
